data.name: Helicopter Simulator 2025 - Real Flight PC/VR
data.detailed_description:
Experience the thrill of flight and the immersion of virtual reality like never before in this cutting-edge helicopter simulator. You can play on PC using a keyboard and mouse or take full control in virtual reality if you have a VR headset. Step into the cockpit of the TG-R66, a highly detailed rescue and marine observation helicopter, and explore vast oceanic environments. Face challenging missions that demand precision, focus, and quick decision-making as you perform sea rescues and observe marine wildlife in their natural habitat.

Helicopter Simulator 2025 - Real Flight PC/VR features 8 distinct liveries for the TG-R66 and lets you choose between flying with a radar system or with rockets and flares installed. Explore a richly crafted ocean world filled with oil rigs, vessels, sea animals, floating platforms, and much more. The level of realism will leave you speechless.

Become a true pilot by learning how to operate every system inside a real helicopter. Step-by-step tutorials will guide you through startup procedures, rescue operations, flare deployment, and other critical skills you will use during missions inspired by real-world scenarios.

The TG-R66 was built to replicate the behavior of an actual helicopter down to the smallest detail. Startup sequences must be followed carefully because missing a step can keep you grounded. But that is all part of the simulation. Practice, improve, and develop your flying abilities to the fullest.

Missions: The game features a wide variety of missions that put your skills to the test. Take on daring rescue operations in stormy seas, engage in precision shooting challenges, transport vital cargo and passengers across vast landscapes, and explore remote areas in search of hidden objectives. Whether you're saving lives, delivering supplies, or uncovering secrets, every mission offers a unique experience that keeps the adventure fresh and exciting.

Full Functional Cockpit and Unmatched Realism
• All cockpit systems are interactive and respond exactly as they would in a real aircraft. Keep an eye on your RPM and altitude—helicopter flight demands constant attention.
• Fly near the limits of altitude or close to rocky coastlines and feel the aircraft respond. Realistic physics replicate the challenges faced by pilots during sea rescue operations.

Sharpen Your Flying Skills
• Aerodynamics and Environmental Awareness – Flying over open waters and between oil platforms requires a sharp eye and steady control. Perfect for pilots looking to master emergency response in tough scenarios.

Physics-Driven Experience

• Choose between Arcade mode for accessible missions and exploration or Realism mode for full helicopter simulation - EXTREMELY REAL.

• Experience true-to-life aerodynamics and environmental effects.

• Fly across open waters, mountains, valleys, villages, forests, beaches, and around oil platforms with precision and focus.

• Every part of the helicopter reacts to real-world physics.

• Full VR support for complete cockpit immersion, but you can also fly without VR. The experience is still incredible!

Helicopter Simulator 2025 - Real Flight PC/VR: For the most immersive and authentic helicopter simulation, your experience begins here!

MAIN FEATURES
• Exceptionally realistic cockpit and helicopter models
• Full interaction with all flight instruments
• Compatible with HOTAS, gamepads, and 1000+ joystick models
• Beginner and advanced control modes to suit all players
• Rockets/Flare support for action missions.
• Expansive scenery including oceans, islands, ships, and offshore rigs
• 8 distinct helicopter paint schemes, with options of add-ons.
• 24 immersive missions – Rescue, Spot, Shooting, Scout
• Free flight mode for open exploration and skill development
• Living environments with sea life, moving ships, rescue teams, and platform crews

Developed by a team of aviation lovers committed to delivering the ultimate flight simulation experience! Both in PC or VR!

data.short_description: Fly the TG-R66 in ultra-realistic rescue and wildlife missions over the ocean. Experience full functional cockpit, real physics, dynamic weather, and immersive controls. Includes 24 missions, free flight mode, multiple liveries, add-ons, and support for HOTAS, gamepads, and joysticks.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 or 10 (64 Bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4590 (AMD FX 8350) or better.
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 970 / AMD equivalent or greater
  • Sound Card: Default
  • VR Support: SteamVR
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 (64 Bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7 6700K equivalent or greater
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1660 / AMD equivalent or greater
  • Sound Card: Default
  • VR Support: SteamVR
